experiment: HLS-S3b-E1 final memory and closed-loop diagnostic

design.decision_rule: empirical-mean exact matching, no exploration bonus; canonical lexicographic tie-break
design.reduced_design_justification: infrequent/high vs frequent/high varies stability interval at high opportunity; frequent/high vs frequent/low varies opportunity at fast changes; no interaction estimate
design.shared_calendar: first nine periods reuse fixed calibration matchings; afterward cycle all six feasible matchings, independent of diagnostic choices; mask gates observed outcomes
design.closed_loop: after common nine-period calibration, each estimator's own matching determines which masked outcomes it receives
design.memory_only_difference: global_mean retains all; recent_mean retains observations with period >= t-W; same empirical mean and neutral 0.5 when no usable sample
design.regret_oracle: exact maximum true-mean value over the same six feasible complete matchings; evaluation only

provenance.source_hash_status: NOT_RECORDED_AT_EXECUTION; runner source hash support and arm-level summaries were added after the rollout; simulation equations and episode records were unchanged

analysis_method.period_curves: means across seeds at each period; periods are not treated as independent samples
analysis_method.recovery: within-seed mean across eligible change events, then interval across seeds
analysis_method.postrun_summary_update: added arm regime/recovery and cross-condition memory-effect summaries from saved episode records; no simulation was rerun or changed

shared_observations.meaning: same outcome observations and timestamps; these are direct finite-instance memory contrasts under the fixed calendar

closed_loop.meaning: feedback distributions diverged; paired regret direction favors WINDOW in sample but uncertainty includes zero

diagnostic_interpretation.causality_limit: closed-loop versus fixed-calendar differences change observation allocation and realized organizational actions; interpret as diagnostic total contrasts, not isolated mediator effects
diagnostic_interpretation.global_mse_limit: unweighted global MSE gives equal weight to all nine pairs; the matching objective depends on a small, regime-relevant subset and pair estimation error can be concentrated on those edges
